Originally discarded as worthless impurities, the crystals attract the attention of representatives of the Techno Union because of their ability to survive the extreme heat. The research and development team discovers that the crystals, dubbed Crystadurium, not only withstand heat and high pressure, but they also resist blaster fire. Working with a design team from

, they create blaster-resistant armor plating by mixing crystal shards into the durasteel alloy used for the Battle Droids' Armor. The war ends before the armor plating is implemented, and the plans are lost when the Techno Union is absorbed by the Empire. Years later the plans are rediscovered by an Imperial librarian, who sells the plans to several arms manufacturers. Although the armor created from these plans is inferior to the original prototypes, it is remarkably effective at stopping blaster fire.
